data.name: The Frog Prince
data.detailed_description:
The Frog Prince is a physics-based multiplayer climbing party game. Play as a frog and jump, climb, and struggle your way toward the princess’s castle at the top.

Every jump matters. Hold the button to charge your jump, release it at the right moment, and try to stay balanced across slippery surfaces, narrow platforms, and momentum-based landings. The higher you climb, the more painful each mistake becomes.

You can take on the challenge alone or climb together with other players. Use your frog’s tongue to grab teammates, save friends from falling, or push them off and keep the victory for yourself.

Between cooperation, betrayal, painful mistakes, and last-second rescues, no one knows whether the journey will end in friendship or complete chaos.

Reach the top, open the princess’s cage, and meet a randomly generated princess. She might be beautiful, adorable, strange—or something entirely unexpected.

But there is only one princess.

Game Features

  • Physics-based charged jumping and movement

  • Slippery platforms, difficult landings, and punishing falls

  • Use your tongue to rescue, assist, or sabotage other players

  • Play alone or climb with friends

  • Travel through snowy mountains, clouds, and a strange fairy-tale world

  • Randomly generated princesses at the end

  • Designed for funny failures, betrayals, and last-second saves

The goal is simple:

Climb all the way to the top, reach the princess, and try not to lose everything along the way.

data.short_description: The Frog Prince is a physics-based climbing party game where every jump can save your run—or ruin it. Charge your leaps, survive slippery platforms, and use your tongue to rescue friends, betray rivals, and race toward a randomly generated princess at the summit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
